tools.name: bitmap_import
tools.description: Embed an image (path relative to the read root) as a bitmap resource. Returns its name, for a `bitmap` node's `resource` parameter.

path.description: Image file relative to the read root (png, jpg, tga, tif, bmp, webp, exr, hdr).

tools.name: command_batch
tools.description: Run several commands in order: steps [{id, params}]. Stops at the first error. Returns {completed, results, failed: {index, id, error} | null}; a failed batch is a tool error.

params.description: Command parameters (see the command's `params` doc). Omitted = defaults; never a dialog.

steps.description: Commands run in order; the batch stops at the first error and reports its index.

tools.name: command_list
tools.description: List engine commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, params doc and whether it can run now.

filter.description: Only entries whose id or label contains this text (case-insensitive).

tools.name: command_run
tools.description: Run an engine command by id with JSON params (see command_list). Runs with defaults, never opens a dialog. Commands given host paths are disabled: use package_open, package_save, bitmap_import and outputs_export.

params.description: Command parameters (see the command's `params` doc). Omitted = defaults; never a dialog.

tools.name: graph_new
tools.description: Add a new graph to the package from a template and open it. Returns {graph, name}.

size.description: Graph size in pixels, a power of two from 16 to 8192 (default 1024).

template.description: Template id: empty, pbr (default: six material outputs), bricks, stone_tiles, wood, metal_plates, rusty_metal, lava, marble, wicker, fabric, ground.

tools.name: library_list
tools.description: The node library: every node's id, label, category, input and output ports and parameters (id, default, range, enum options). Filter by text or category.

category.description: Only nodes in this library category, e.g. "Noises", "Patterns", "Filters/Blurs".

filter.description: Only nodes whose id or label contains this text.

tools.name: node_add
tools.description: Add a node to the open graph (optionally wired from another node's output). Returns {id}.

at.description: Graph position `[x, y]` (default: right of `connectFrom`, else the origin).

connectFrom.description: Wire `{node, port?}`'s output into the new node's first input.

params.description: Parameter values by id (see `library_list`): numbers, `[x, y]`, `"#rrggbb"`, enum indices.

tools.name: node_connect
tools.description: Wire an output port of one node into an input port of another (replacing what fed that input).

fromPort.description: Source output port id (default: its first output).

toPort.description: Target input port id (default: its first input).

tools.name: node_param
tools.description: Set one parameter of a node.

value.description: The value: a number, `[x, y]`, `"#rrggbb"`, an enum index, a curve `[[x, y], …]` or a gradient `[[pos, color], …]`.

tools.name: outputs_export
tools.description: Cook a graph at full size and write every output (base color, normal, roughness, …) into a folder relative to the write root. Returns the written files.

depth.description: 8, 16 or 32 bits (default: the graph's output format).

dir.description: Output folder relative to the write root (created if missing; `.` = the root).

format.description: png (default), jpg, tga, tif, bmp, webp, exr, hdr.

tools.name: package_open
tools.description: Open an .sbs or .mcraft package (path relative to the read root). Returns the session; `package.warnings` lists what an SBS file holds that MaterialCraft can't read yet (missing nodes are kept as placeholders).

path.description: Forward-slash path relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: package_save
tools.description: Save the package (path relative to the write root; omit to save to its own file). Saves SBS (.sbs, the main format) unless the path ends in .mcraft.

path.description:
Forward-slash path relative to the write root (`.sbs` is appended unless it ends in `.sbs`
or `.mcraft`). Omit to save to the package's own file.

tools.name: session_inspect
tools.description: The whole session as JSON: package, graphs, the open graph's nodes (definition, parameters, base parameters, ports, cook errors, timings, mean values), connections, frames, comments, pins, exposed inputs, views and history.

tools.name: ui_input
tools.description: Bridge mode: synthesize mouse, keyboard and text input in the app window (clicks, drags between node ports, scrolling, shortcuts, typing). Positions are window points (see ui_inspect for node rectangles).

events.description:
Input events in window points, applied in order on the next frames. Each is one of:
{"type":"move","pos":[x,y]}, {"type":"down"|"up","pos":[x,y],"button":"left"|"right"|"middle"},
{"type":"click"|"doubleClick","pos":[x,y],"button"?}, {"type":"drag","from":[x,y],"to":[x,y],"button"?,"steps"?},
{"type":"scroll","pos":[x,y],"delta":[dx,dy]}, {"type":"key","key":"A"|"Enter"|"Space"|…,"modifiers"?:["ctrl","shift","alt"]},
{"type":"text","text":"…"}.

tools.name: ui_inspect
tools.description: Bridge mode: the app's UI state (panels, windows, graph view camera, node rectangles on screen, toasts).

tools.name: ui_menu_invoke
tools.description: Bridge mode: activate a menu item by id like a click (may open a window). ui.menu.list lists ids.

id.description: Menu item id from the app's `ui.menu.list`, e.g. `file.save`, `ui.newGraph`, `ui.view.library`.

tools.name: ui_screenshot
tools.description: Bridge mode: PNG of the whole app window (downscaled to 2048 px a side at most).

tools.name: view_render
tools.description: Headless: render the material on the 3D view's scene, or a node's output (view 2d), as a PNG up to 2048 px a side. In bridge mode use view_screenshot.

displacement.description: With `hq`: displacement depth in scene radii (default 0.04).

full.description: Cook at the full graph size instead of the preview size.

hq.description:
3D beauty render: real displacement from the height output, ambient occlusion and a
shadowed key light (slower).

node.description: 2D: the node to show (default: the 2D view's node, else the first output).

scene.description: 3D scene: rounded_cube, cube, sphere, cylinder, plane, torus, material_ball.

tiling.description: 3D: UV repeats of the material on the scene for this render only.

view.description: `3d` (default: the material on the 3D view's scene) or `2d` (a node's output).

yaw.description: Camera yaw/pitch in degrees for this render only.

tools.name: view_screenshot
tools.description: Bridge mode: PNG of the live app's 3D or 2D view.
